QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_15

question.text: What shall the Clearing Corporation do when funds received for mutual fund orders cannot be settled with the AMC within the CC-specified time period?

answer.text: Initiate a refund of the funds to the investor
Hold the funds indefinitely until settlement is possible
Settle the funds within 3 working days regardless
Settle the funds within 7 working days regardless

explanation.text: The Logic: When funds received by the Clearing Corporation cannot be settled with the AMC within the time period specified by the CC, the CC shall initiate a refund of those funds. The receipt note from the CC to the investor is generated within five working days. The Trap: The CC does not hold funds indefinitely, and there is no fixed 3-working-day or 7-working-day mandatory settlement window — the time period is the one specified by the CC. Note: Stem reworded so that it asks what the CC must do, matching the refund action described in the keyed option.
